paper_title: Constraints on light decaying dark matter candidates from 16 years of INTEGRAL/SPI observations
notes: Decaying DM search with INTEGRAL/SPI. The paper's primary result is on the DM decay rate (Gamma) vs mass; recast into ALP-photon coupling (Fig 3, ma in keV vs g_agamma in GeV^-1 spanning ~100 keV to 16 MeV, y-axis 1e-23 to 1e-15). Data points are approximate reads from the exclusion curve (Fig 3), not from a table - numerical values are uncertain. Not a haloscope (NFW halo decay), so no local DM density assumption. Paper also presents AxionElectron (g_ae from FSR, Fig 4) and sterile-neutrino mixing (Fig 5) bounds; AxionPhoton (Fig 3) chosen as the flagship line result.
